content:
“Offering both a little braininess and bitterness, this bowl needs to be consumed before it spoils.”— *Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide* p.104

**Brain Fungus Soup** is a cooked meal in *Fallout 76*.

A small blue bowl containing soup, similar in appearance to many other soups in game. It restores some HP and provides a temporary bonus to Intelligence, at the cost of increased rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Brain Fungus (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Brain Fungus | | Brain Fungus Soup (1) | 

- Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having picked up brain fungus for the first time.
- Generated by the Communist Collectron Station under the *Proletariat* protocol.
